--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_custom_native_thresholds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import logging
+import pickle
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog import make_filtering_bound_logger
+from structlog.testing import CapturingLogger
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("threshold", [-5, 5, 15, 25, 35, 45, 55])
+def test_custom_threshold(threshold):
+    cls = make_filtering_bound_logger(threshold)
+    assert cls is make_filtering_bound_logger(threshold)
+    assert pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(cls)) is cls
+    backend = CapturingLogger()
+    logger = cls(backend, [], {})
+    assert logger.get_effective_level() == threshold
+    for name, level in [("debug", 10), ("info", 20), ("warning", 30), ("error", 40), ("critical", 50)]:
+        backend.calls.clear()
+        getattr(logger, name)("event")
+        assert logger.is_enabled_for(level) is (level >= threshold)
+        assert len(backend.calls) == int(level >= threshold)
+        backend.calls.clear()
+        logger.log(level, "event")
+        assert len(backend.calls) == int(level >= threshold)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("threshold", [15, 25, 55])
+async def test_custom_async_threshold(threshold):
+    backend = CapturingLogger()
+    logger = make_filtering_bound_logger(threshold)(backend, [], {})
+    await logger.ainfo("event")
+    assert len(backend.calls) == int(20 >= threshold)
+    backend.calls.clear()
+    await logger.alog(logging.ERROR, "event")
+    assert len(backend.calls) == int(40 >= threshold)
spec.notes: The question does not require support for custom numeric event levels. It requires arbitrary minimum thresholds while preserving existing numeric dispatch semantics.
spec.question: Extend `make_filtering_bound_logger` to accept any integer minimum level, including negative integers and values between or above the standard levels. Named methods and their async variants must retain the existing threshold rule: a standard logging level is enabled exactly when it is greater than or equal to the requested minimum. Introspection must report the requested minimum. Numeric `log` and `alog` calls at the existing supported standard levels must obey the same rule. Repeated factory calls with the same integer must return the identical class, and that class must survive a pickle round trip by identity. Keep the existing pre-created classes, string-level handling, aliases, and unsupported numeric dispatch behavior unchanged. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
